snippet.title: Ghost Battalion Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1643700/Ghost_Battalion

Ghost Battalion is a 1st/3rd person shooter featuring vehicles, ships, jet packs, multiple soldier classes, and full PvE/PvP gameplay. This clip shows a small part of the action - the game includes 14 unique maps, over 30 weapons, space flight, Co‑Op, Versus modes, and much more.

Try the Demo and leave a review if you get the game and like it: 
Thank you to everyone who supported and helped make this project a reality!
#indiegame #indiedev #ghostbattalion #newrelease #fps #shootergames
